# Base World

> A stylized 3D open world for the Base ecosystem. Explore protocol districts, complete quests, talk to AI agents, and run DeFi.

Base World is a browser game. Play offline with a local save and simulated transactions, or online in a shared world with Privy login and real Base mainnet actions (swaps, liquidity, lending, transfers), capped per transaction.

## Play

- Home: /
- Offline: /offline
- Online: /online

## Districts

Aerodrome, Virtuals, Morpho, Bankr, Uniswap, Aave, Kickoff, and Base Plaza.

## Stack

Next.js, React Three Fiber, Privy, Supabase, Base.
